body: To the editor: I have lived on Vine Street for 14 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

Owen Kaczmarek, Cedar Hollow
